ops.title: prove-ci-follow: stop retrying terminal GitHub read failures forever
ops.description: Owner: prove-ci-follow change owner. HEAD 77dbcdf5bd98732dc8a361136b58b24c584a332a. Evidence: install.py:653-659 catches every GithubError and sleeps POLL_SECONDS without a deadline or terminal-error exit. Errors from hook creation and default-branch/run reads are included, so a persistent authorization or not-found error can strand a failed proof even before any running CI was observed. Previously the deadline ended this path. Next executable step: separate terminal/read-failure handling from the unlimited wait on an observed running job, propagate terminal errors as DriveError, and add permanent-failure plus transient-recovery cases. Review was code-only; no tests were run.

ops.text: A terminal GitHub/hook read failure records a diagnostic BLOCKED result; transient failures still retry; genuinely running CI can exceed the proof timeout.
